message.reasoning_content: No goods, cash low. Buy 1 unit at high price ~12 alashi? cash after buy 2.74 alashi, goods 1. License income 20-60 already. Holding goods only useful if can produce and sell later. Round 5 market: buy 1 unit for 12 alashi, then rounds 5 action produce 3, round 6 sell ~4 units at declining prices. Marginal. Alternatively keep cash for rank. Bank rank by cash+hard; cash matters. Buying reduces cash now but selling round 6 recovers. Selling 4 units next round: prices 12,10,9,8 = 39 alashi vs 12 spent, but cash devaluation round 6 start: cash*0.62. Spending 12 now saves from devaluation, sell revenue fresh. Likely profitable. But opponents also sell. Buy seems better than pass.
